column1: # Actions: WARN (report, do not fail), IGNORE (do not report), FAIL.
# Every IGNORE below names the control that makes the finding wrong for this
# application. A tuned-out rule with no reason is how a scan report stops being
# read — the next person cannot tell a deliberate exception from an old excuse.
# The application is a single-page app behind a nonce CSP. ZAP reports the
# absence of a CSP on the 404 and asset responses, which do not execute script.

column4: CSP is set on the shell; asset and error responses carry no script.

column1: # Cookies are __Host- prefixed, HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax. ZAP flags
# the absence of Secure when scanning over plain HTTP in CI, which is an
# artefact of the scan environment, not of the application: loadConfig refuses
# to start in production without an https PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

column4: Scanned over http in CI; Secure is set whenever cookieSecure is on.

column1: # Timestamp disclosure: fiscal years and period numbers look like epochs to a

column4: Fiscal years and periods, not timestamps.

column1: # Informational rules worth seeing but not worth failing a release over.
